biggest_catch: You must open the account in person at a Summit Credit Union branch to get this offer — online opening does not qualify for the $300 promotion.
catches: Open a new Summit checking account in person at a participating Summit Credit Union branch (Madison, Milwaukee, Green Bay, Wisconsin footprint).
You receive $100 at the time of in-branch account opening.
Earn an additional $200 by making 20 qualifying debit card transactions with the new debit card within the first 60 days of account opening.

Based on the credit union's standard debit-card promotion terms: only the member's first Summit checking account qualifies; you or any signer may not have an existing Summit consumer checking account, have closed an account within the past 24 months, or have been paid a Summit promotional premium in the past 24 months.
A Summit checking account requires a Primary Savings account ($1 minimum to open).
Minimum to open a checking account is $25.

The fetched easy300 promo page does not state the bonus payout timeline, the exact end date of the promotion, or tax reporting; treat the promotion as time-limited and assume the bonus may be reported on IRS forms (per Summit's standard debit-card promo disclosures).
